svg.title: The action DAG the scheduler builds
svg.desc: Illustrative retrieve: the event DAG, CHUGG's timed motions per entity, the action DAG with same-entity, occupancy and event-level edges before and after Reduce, and the Schedule array.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: ResponseFromTrajectories turns CHUGG's timed motions into an ADG: a chain per entity (Type 1), an edge from every earlier occupant of an overlapping footprint (Type 2), and an

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: edge from the last action of each event to the first action of every event that depends on it. Reduce() removes implied edges; the result is sent as Schedule.nodes.
